gaps.what: No page opened gives an area or a border for the Theban hegemony; the extent is Cliopatria's shape with trims. Argos, Tegea, Elis and Achaea were not dated one by one; Theban holds in Thessaly after Pelopidas's death (364) are not on the pages.
Euboea joining Thebes (370) has no year of its own on the Epaminondas page (undated footnote); confidence 1.

The Thracian and Chalcidian cells of Cliopatria's -366 shape (Abdera, Cardia, Torone, Amphipolis), Corfu, Mytilene and the Cyclades after 355, and the year Euboea returned to Athens are unverified; accession dates of the members are not on the page.
The -360 loss of the Thracian Chersonese to the Odrysians rests on the Odrysian dossier (Cotys I page), not opened here; confidence 1.
Start year of the Phocian occupation of Orchomenus, Coronea and Corsiae (bridge -347, confidence 1); the Third Sacred War page gives only 'by 347-346'.

counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Thessalian League and Pherae (Alexander of Pherae)

problems: sacred-band-of-thebes (-379..-362) and thebans (-361..-338) are one Theban state in substance (the Boeotian League under Theban leadership); kept as two dossiers because the brief lists both slugs, with the split moved from Cliopatria's -351/-350 to Mantinea (-362/-361). The orchestrator may merge them under sacred-band-of-thebes with both Names in cliopatria_names; greek-city-states /ledger/42 would then name sacred-band-of-thebes.

Cliopatria 'Sacred Band of Thebes' is the Theban hegemony's sphere, not the 300-man corps; the row's Byzantium and Izmir cells are wrong (the 364 fleet 'achieved no lasting gains') and belong, for Byzantium, to the Second Athenian League until 355.

Page budget exceeded: eleven pages for the three new states (budget 1-2 each) because the Thebes, Theban hegemony and Boeotian League pages are silent on territory; the three older dossiers (peloponnesian-league, odrysian-kingdom, cimmerian-bosporus) were kept from an earlier run, validated and not re-read in full.

Mirror mismatches left for the greek-city-states owner: /ledger/28 (-377 league founding, the page says 378), /ledger/31 and /ledger/37 (-366 loss and -350 gain with sacred-band-of-thebes; the pages give -369..-362), /ledger/42 (-337 gain from thebans; thebans ends August 338). macedonian-empire has no event for the Macedonian garrison at Thebes (338).

Second Athenian League: the league page ends the alliance in 355, the Chaeronea page dissolves it in 338; Cliopatria's -338 is kept with 355-338 as Athens's rump. Written as a state (not an umbrella) so that Attica is drawn; Athens needs its own dossier.
No area figure exists on any page opened for the three new states; areas are cell counts from the gazetteer (notes file).
